title: Government's Plans to Prevent Racial Discrimination at Workplaces
what_it_is: Government's Plans to Prevent Racial Discrimination at Workplaces

sections.label: Workplace discrimination complaints received
sections.summary: Between 2011 and 2015, MOM and TAFEP received about 400 complaints yearly, with under 10% on race or religion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: Between 2011 and 2015, MOM and TAFEP received on average of about 400 complaints of alleged discriminatory workplace practices each year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: Less than 10%, or about 30, of these relate to race or religion.

sections.label: Employers warned or curtailed
sections.summary: Since then, 10 employers were warned for race- or religion-related discrimination and 12 had Work Pass privileges curtailed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: Since then, 10 employers have received warnings for race- or religion-related discrimination, and another 12 employers have had their Work Pass privileges curtailed.

sections.label: TAFEP public education campaign
sections.summary: TAFEP will step up its public education campaign to make people more conscious and sensitive in embracing diversity in a multiracial workforce.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: TAFEP will step up its public education campaign to make people more conscious and sensitive in embracing diversity in a multiracial workforce.

sections.label: MOM 2014 fair employment survey
sections.summary: In MOM's 2014 survey, two in three firms reported implementing fair employment practices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: In the survey done by MOM in 2014, two in three firms reported that they implemented fair employment practices.

sections.label: Award recipients since 2010
sections.summary: Thirty-two organisations have received this award so far since it was implemented in 2010.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: Thirtytwo organisations have received this award so far since it was implemented in 2010.

sections.label: Curtailing Work Pass privileges
sections.summary: Work Pass privileges have been curtailed depending on case severity, and all companies have heeded with no repeat cases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: Depending on the severity of the case, we have curtailed their Work Pass privileges as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: That, itself, has been effective because when we curtailed their Work Passes, over a specific period, it has an outcome.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: So far, all the companies have heeded and there were no repeat cases.

sections.label: Survey employer and employee sides
sections.summary: The next survey in 2018 will cover both employer and employee sides to better sense the ground.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: For the survey that we intend to conduct in the next session – the previous survey was done in 2014, so the next one is in 2018 – our intent is, of course, to survey both sides – employer and employee side – in order to get a better view about the sensing on the ground, so we will take that into consideration.

sections.label: Stable discrimination complaints, multi-pronged approach
sections.summary: About 300 complaints in 2015 stayed stable, about 10% on race and religion, and the multi-pronged approach has been effective.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: In 2015, that year itself, which is the latest survey, about 300.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: So, the numbers remain stable in terms of discrimination complaints of all sorts, which is, maybe, say, six areas, and a very small minority, about 10%, is on race and religion issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: We feel that with this stability – not that we can eliminate all the discrimination – the current practice of a multi-pronged approach – in terms of imposing the penalties of curtailing Work Passes, as well as TAFEP's counselling and advisory work with the companies and following up 	Page: 26 closely with the companies – has been effective.
